description: B.J. Sarath de Fonseka v. Union Trust and Investment Limited and Another B.J. Sarath de Fonseka v. Union Trust and Investment Limited and Another View More before Hon. Anil Gooneratne, J.
parties: B.J. Sarath de Fonseka v. Union Trust and Investment Limited and Another B.J. Sarath de Fonseka v. Union Trust and Investment Limited and Another View More
keywords: The Appellant challenged the District Court’s judgment holding him liable as guarantor under a Guarantee Bond, arguing that no valid demand had been made on him. Held - letter of demand had been duly dispatched; cause of action against the guarantor had therefore arisen. Appeal dismissed with costs.
legistation: Article 138(1) of the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
